decisions.reason: Although an accelerator program is peripheral to a German machinery maker’s core business, its continued home-page prominence suggests visible commitment that makes management likely to persist unless results clearly fail again.
The dedicated product page across both years indicates ongoing investment and a sustainability narrative worth defending, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal less likely than continuation.

This plant is highly visible on the home page, framed as a flagship technological advance, and closely aligned with machinery manufacturing, which strongly favors continued support despite any disappointing early outcomes.
